A '''war''' was fought over the [[Dreypa's Oubliette]], also known as the "Jebble Box." After the war was over and all combatants were killed, the crew of the [[Uhumele]] came into possession of the box. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Schurk-Heren]] later looked back on the war as the reason why he had the Jebble Box.
